name: claude-legal-kit
description: Portable Claude Code foundation for law firms — conduct rules, rules of practice, skills, document templates, and firm structure that install into any firm's home folder and stay current through a one-way sync.

kit.description: Files synced into a firm's home folder. Updates here propagate via the /sync workflow ('load the latest kit updates').

files.note: The entire practice-kit: conduct rules (communication, save-load), shared-library (skills, rules of practice, document templates, integrations, jurisdictions, practice-areas, filing-pipeline), new-matter-templates, vocabulary, the research-library structure, scripts, and the practice-kit's own manifest.json that governs firm-to-matter sync. Firm-added research entries are not kit-tracked, so /sync leaves them untouched.
The cross-matter registry structure (parties, opposing-counsel, courts, judges, experts) — README files only. Firm-added party and counsel stamps live alongside and are not kit-tracked.
The per-member workspace template. Copied to members/<name>/ for each firm member at setup.
The drive-registry guide. Individual drive files (one per storage location) are firm-specific and not kit-tracked.

The /sync skill — the firm-level command behind 'load the latest kit updates'. Reconciles every kit-managed file against the firm's copy three ways and proposes changes one by one. Kit-managed, so the skill itself stays current. Its reconciliation engine, bin/sync-report, ships only in the kit repo and runs from a fresh fetch — it is never installed into the firm home.

bootstrap.description: One-time files copied at init only. Never overwritten by /sync — the firm owns them.

files.note: The firm's root control file. Carries {{PLACEHOLDERS}} the firm fills in; references the kit's conduct rules as the binding behavioral source.
Firm identity profile — legal name, office, members, fee structures, letterhead, signature blocks. {{PLACEHOLDERS}} filled by the firm.
Keeps the private vault and client matters off the cloud.
Records which kit the firm tracks and the kit commit it was last synced to. Stamped with the kit's HEAD SHA at init time; /sync bumps the pin thereafter.

scaffold.description: Empty directories created at init, each with a .gitkeep.
